Build the (possibly scope-bearing) server-side analysis run call

Source: R/analysis.R
dot-analysis_run_call.Rd

Constructs the unevaluated DataSHIELD call for omopAnalysisRunDS / omopAnalysisRunAssignDS. params is JSON/base64-encoded for Opal transport (.ds_encode); scope_args is spliced as closed, named arguments. Table scopes are bare symbols, never nested calls. combine is passed by name so absent scope arguments cannot shift it into the wrong positional slot.

Usage

.analysis_run_call(
  fn,
  res_symbol,
  name,
  params,
  scope_args,
  combine,
  date_handling = NULL
)

Arguments

fn

Character; the server method name.

res_symbol

Character; the server-side handle symbol.

name

Character; the catalog entry name.

params

Named list of parameter values.

scope_args

NULL or the closed named argument list returned by .analysis_scope_expr.

combine

Character; "union" or "intersect".

Value

An unevaluated call.
